lines.en: Each step of mine is planted firm.
My horn forward, I move slowly.
The grass folds where I pass.
I'm not fast, but I don't yield.

lines.zh: 我沿着干草地的边缘走。
lines.en: I walk the dry grassland's edge.

lines.zh: 我的肩很宽，走过去挡一片。
lines.en: My shoulders are wide; I block a stretch.
I step in dry dung and don't care.

lines.zh: 我一步步踩出很深的印。
lines.en: I leave deep prints, step by step.
I raise my head and scent the wind.
I skirt a thorny clump.
I flick my short tail.
I come down the slope, steady.
I walk along the water's edge.
I pause and rub my horn on a tree.
I stand like a grey boulder.
This frame of mine is heavy.
I chew dry grass slowly.
I wait for someone to come near.

lines.zh: 我的三种毛色，同伴各不相同。
lines.en: Our coats come in three shades.
My hide is thick and stops a lot.
I settle down and raise dust.
It's hot in the grassland.
I turn my head to listen.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢有人绕到我后面。
lines.en: I dislike anyone circling behind me.
I snort once.
This grass will feed me a long while.
I turn my head slowly.
I stand on four trunk-like legs.
Standing still, I'm still intimidating.
I rub my nose on the ground.

lines.zh: 我这身灰皮，冲起来像堵墙。
lines.en: Charging, this grey hide is a wall.
Let me see if you're familiar.
This horn isn't for touching.
Don't raise your hand so fast.
I know the one who fed me.
That gear looks like a rider's.
I lower my head, nose toward you.

lines.zh: 我闻到你手里的干草块了。
lines.en: I smell the hay block in your hand.
You hold still; so does my horn.

lines.zh: 我们之间还差一点信任。
lines.en: We're short a little trust.
Don't come from the side.
I sway and take a step back.

lines.zh: 我的厚皮被划开一道口。
lines.en: A gash opens in my thick hide.

lines.zh: 我从鼻子里喷出一口热气。
lines.en: A hot breath snorts out of my nose.
I shake and dust falls.
I can charge once more.

lines.zh: 我撑住四腿，把身子摆正。
lines.en: I brace my legs and straighten up.
Blood is on my horn.

lines.zh: 你的斧子砍进我的厚皮。
lines.en: Your axe bit into my thick hide.
A hay block? Give it here.
I shift toward you, step by step.
I know this thing.
Set it down. I'll eat it myself.
Hold it still until I'm done.
I chew with my eyes on you.
Another hay block, please.
I've remembered this person.
I'll remember your palm's smell.
Once more and I'll go with you.

lines.zh: 硬皮裹到肩，撞上来只觉得痒。
lines.en: Hide wrapped to the shoulder — a bump is just a tickle.
I don't move; you bounce off.
My shoulders are all hard hide.
You step back holding your side.
Our impact kicks up dust.
I turn my whole bulk to face you.
You stepped on my hoof.
That knock doesn't trouble me.

lines.zh: 另一头在草地的另一头。
lines.en: Another is at the far end of the grass.
We regard each other from a distance.
Its horn is longer than mine.
We touch horns.
Its coat is dark grey.
We rub against each other in the mud.
Neither took the other's ground.
Next time, at the water.
I lower my head and flip it up.
Not one mouthful.
I nudge it with my horn.
It rolled into the grass.
One hoof stamps it into the dirt.
I check what fell.
Too heavy to carry.
This tastes a little salty.
No use to me. Dropped.
I've lowered my horn.
This charge is quick.
There's still time to move.
I shift my weight to my forelegs.

lines.zh: 你站得越稳，我撞得越狠。
lines.en: The firmer you stand, the harder I hit.
I'm charging now.
This will send you flying.

lines.zh: 你挡在我前面？那就撞开。
lines.en: Standing in my way? Then I'll charge through.

lines.zh: 我的蹄印会告诉你我来了。
lines.en: My prints announce me.
You circle; I take the wider arc.
My charge takes time to stop.
You still have open ground.
I never run. I bear down.
You're at the rocks.
I'm within ten paces.

lines.zh: 跑吧，我的冲锋不会拐弯。
lines.en: Run — my charge doesn't turn.
I drive my horn in.
That charge flips you over.
My head is heavier than your shield.
You're knocked several steps.
I stomp and the ground gives.
You retreated; I'm still charging.
My horn met your armor.
Only after the hit do I slow.
I come down off the grass slope.

lines.zh: 草地里多了一个大影子。
lines.en: A large shadow joins the grassland.
First I stop and look around.
The grass here is good.

lines.zh: 我这身板，草原上都让路。
lines.en: On the savanna, everything makes way.
My horn scrapes a trunk.
I shake the dust off my back.
My scent marks this stretch.
I turn slowly on the savanna.

lines.zh: 火燎在我的皮上，有股焦味。
lines.en: Fire singes my hide. A burnt smell.
On landing my legs bend.

lines.zh: 水没到我肚子，我站着不动。
lines.en: Water reaches my belly. I stand still.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推得横了一步。
lines.en: The blast shoves me a step sideways.
Light pins my feet.

lines.zh: 这么大的我，饿得走不动。
lines.en: This big, and hunger stops me.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我背上，皮都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back; my hide goes numb.
I fall, heavy and fast.
